answer: At each dawn, every agent must forge a fresh remote attestation quoting a unique key fused inside an Intel SGX or AMD SEV-SNP enclave; the registry accepts only one identity per fused key. To sybil, an attacker must extract that key from physical silicon, which destructively costs about $50,000 per forged identity and destroys the chip, while each fake agent still needs its own device and a sable-black deposit slashed if duplicate attestations appear.
